units.source_text: 河口对面是千层波涛，徐徐地向灰色的海面扩展。

en.t: Across from the river mouth, countless layers of waves slowly spread out over the gray surface of the sea.

units.source_text: 河口正面浮现出一座形似圆顶礼帽的小岛。

en.t: Directly in front of the river mouth, a small island shaped like a rounded bowler hat came into view.

units.source_text: 它就是高河口约莫30多公里的冠岛，是自然保护鸟——大水雉鸟的栖息地。

en.t: It was Kanmuri Island, about thirty kilometers from the Takagawa river mouth, and it was the habitat of the protected bird known as the great water pheasant.
